children: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright issued an emergency order requiring Tri-State Generation and Transmission Association, Southwest Power Pool, Platte River Power Authority, Salt River Project, Pacific Power, and Colorado Springs Utilities to take all necessary measures to ensure Unit 1 of the Craig Station in Craig, Colorado, is ready to operate. According to Sina Finance, the U.S. Department of Energy said in an email statement that the order takes effect on September 27, 2026, and remains in force until December 25, 2026.

title: US Energy Secretary Orders Colorado Coal Plant to Remain Ready
